name: menorah-production-qa

scripts.test:monitoring: node validate-monitoring-config.mjs && node --test validate-monitoring-config.test.mjs validate-alertmanager-delivery.test.mjs docker-metrics-gateway.test.mjs docker-stats-exporter.test.mjs && bash test-monitoring-native.sh
